subject: INLA crash with large besag model

messages.author: aae8e9f66c6ae74f
messages.subject: INLA crash with large besag model
parts:
I'm trying to get a large INLA model running and am experiencing problems on both a windows machine and a linux server. In both places I can run the model on a subset of the data (4000 rows of data) successfully, but not the full dataset (over 100k rows of data), but I get different errors leading to crashes on the two different systems. The model is :

rich.analysis <- inla(c(scale(log(TD))) ~ taxon_alpha.s + z.et1.s  + z.et2.s + mst.s +
                      + f(ID, model = "besag", graph = "adj.txt",   scale.model=TRUE,
                          hyper = list(prec = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(0.1,0.5)))),
                      family = "gaussian",
                      lincomb = all.lincombs,
                      control.compute = list(dic=TRUE),
                      control.family = list( 
                      hyper = list(prec = list(initial = 0, fixed=T))),
                      data = variables@data, control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
verbose = TRUE)
